antiExamples.name: Segmented/exclusive selection
antiExamples.jsx:
<ButtonGroup>
  <Button appearance={view === 'list' ? 'primary' : 'default'} onClick={() => setView('list')}>List</Button>
  <Button appearance={view === 'grid' ? 'primary' : 'default'} onClick={() => setView('grid')}>Grid</Button>
</ButtonGroup>
antiExamples.reason: Mutually exclusive selection is a different interaction pattern - Button Group does not manage selection state or exclusivity.
